title: 第9章 掌门之位有德者居之第10章 内乱七杀来袭
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
大寿前三个月，
林家村的那几个杂役弟子，却主动找上了陈默。
不是求办事，
是来辞行的，
当了十年杂役，心中的那点少年意气，在日复一日的劳动中磨平，20多岁的青年，竟然就带上了一丝暮气，说话间小心翼翼，身材佝偻。
那外出打拼的少年郎，又有几个能衣锦还乡？
江湖啊，
本就不适合普通人！
“叨扰您，护法，”
“您是我们林家村的骄傲！”
“婉儿师姐身份高贵，我们见不到她，劳您转达一句。”
陈默没有挽留，只是摆了一顿送行酒，又送了他们一些银子，算是尽了同乡之谊。
“一路顺风……”
至此，紫衣门林姓者，唯他与林婉儿。
看着他们离开的背影，
陈默忽然有些想念小草与父亲。
“也不知道，桃花开了吗？”
……
大寿当天，
紫衣门从未像今天这般热闹过。

山门张灯结彩，从山脚到山顶，一路红绸铺地，灯笼高悬。
来来往往的江湖人士络绎不绝，
有头有脸的掌门、帮主，独来独往的游侠、散修，甚至还有一些朝廷的人。
放在几十年前，
谁敢想？
那时候紫衣门就是个三流小派，发请帖都没人搭理。
但现在不一样了。
为了平衡江湖正邪势力，沧澜朝廷有着扶持正道势力。
紫衣门运气好，赶上了这股东风。
几十年间，
从一个不起眼的小门派，一跃成为正道三大领袖之一，与传承千年的天音庙、真武观并驾齐驱，
江湖人最是现实。
你有实力，
我就给你面子。
所以今天，该来的都来了。
……
陈默站在山门口，看着络绎不绝的人群，脸上挂着标准的护法式微笑。
“张掌门，里边请。”
“李帮主，久仰久仰。”
“王老英雄，您能来真是蓬荜生辉...”

一天下来，
脸都笑僵了。
他把守山门，巡查，核查各路来宾的身份。
content_en:
Three months before my birthday,
The handyman disciples from Linjia Village took the initiative to find Chen Mo.
Not asking for help,
I came here to say goodbye.
After ten years of working as a handyman, the youthful spirit in his heart was worn away by day-to-day labor. The young man in his 20s actually had a trace of old age, spoke cautiously, and had a stooped figure.
Of those young men who go out to work hard, how many of them can return home in fine clothes?
Jianghu,
It is not suitable for ordinary people!
"I'm disturbing you, Dharma Protector,"
"You are the pride of our Linjia Village!"
"Senior Sister Wan'er has a noble status. We can't see her. Please convey this message."
Chen Mo didn't try to persuade them to stay, he just gave them a farewell banquet and gave them some money, which was considered as a show of friendship with fellow villagers.
"Have a nice trip..."
So far, the only people with the surname Lin in the Purple Clothes Sect are he and Lin Wan'er.
Watching their leaving figures,
Chen Mo suddenly missed Xiaocao and his father.
"I don't know. Is the peach blossom blooming?"
…
On the day of my birthday,
Ziyimen has never been as lively as it is today.
The mountain gate is decorated with lanterns and colorful decorations. From the foot of the mountain to the top of the mountain, the ground is paved with red silk and lanterns are hung high.
There is an endless stream of people coming and going,
There are respectable leaders and gang leaders, solitary rangers, casual cultivators, and even some people from the imperial court.
A few decades ago,
Who dares to think?
At that time, the Ziyi Sect was just a third-rate sect, and no one paid any attention to invitations sent out.
But it's different now.
In order to balance the forces of good and evil in the world, the Canglan court has forces that support the right path.
Ziyimen was lucky enough to catch up with this trend.
Over the decades,
From an inconspicuous small sect, he has become one of the three leaders of the righteous path, keeping pace with Tianyin Temple and Zhenwu Temple, which have been passed down for thousands of years.
Jianghu people are the most realistic.
You have strength,
I'll give you face.
So today, everything that should come has come.
…
Chen Mo stood at the gate of the mountain, looking at the endless crowd of people, with a standard protector-style smile on his face.
"Master Zhang, please come inside."
"Gang Leader Li, I have admired you for a long time."
"Hero Wang, it's really a blessing to have you here..."
At the end of the day,
His face froze with laughter.
He guarded the mountain gate, patrolled and verified the identities of various guests.
